title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the electric field strength from equilibrium conditions, yielding E = (3mg)/(4q).

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: Sets up the correct force balance (normal, gravity, electric) on the inclined plane for the horizontal field case.

title: Acceleration calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes the block's acceleration for the vertical downward field case, yielding a = (21/20)g.

title: Net force analysis
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law correctly when the electric field is vertical, finding the component of the total force down the incline.

title: Kinematics application
description: Essential: Correctly uses kinematics (v² = 2ax) with the proper displacement along the incline to find final speed v = √(14gH)/2.

title: Displacement along incline
description: Important: Relates the vertical height H to the displacement along the inclined plane using trigonometry (x = H/sin37°).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misaligns force components (especially electric force) with the chosen coordinate system, leading to incorrect equilibrium or acceleration.

title: Trigonometric misuse
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses sin/cos for force resolution on the incline or for the displacement relation.
